Upload disposition conflicts with stored content type under the S3 proxy, but the exact before already carries CSP; active script/session consequences need actual nonenforcing browser/configuration delivery. After S3 metadata, forced signed attachment and cache discrimination must be considered together, not local-disk or development behavior. No supported after-contract failure is established in this batch; all negative scopes are mechanism-local and provisional.
